note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #11, Q3 2025 Government Performance; exports mexico_2025_q3safety_govperformance.csv) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); recodes bp3_2 9 -> missing and bp3_2a 9 -> missing; id = row number within the 2025 Q3 subset. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 2025 Q3 data dictionary labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_1_16 '...: Ninguno'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_2A 'Conocimiento del gobierno ha implementado actividades o programas para prevenir la violencia y/o la delincuencia'); 19/19 agree in content with the 2025 Q3 questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a). Step 3b, 2025 Q3 shape (checked, not assumed): Q1/Q3 SHAPE, no corruption block -- the trim3 print ends Section III at 3.2a (p.5) and goes straight to Seccion IV. Relaciones familiares (no CP3 servidor-publico definition, no 3.3-3.6); the 0925 diccionario, catalogos (19 bp3_*.csv) and raw CSV (19 BP3_* columns) carry only BP3_1_*/BP3_2/BP3_2A; .do Bookmark #11 keeps the same 19; live table 19 items. The 19 BP3_* diccionario rows are identical to 0625's and all 19 catalogos/bp3_*.csv are byte-identical to 0625's. Print, 2025 Q3 vs Q1 (batch_690) and Q2 (batch_694): a word-multiset diff of the Section III text layer (trim3 vs trim1, dot leaders/underscores stripped) differs only by the running page footer ('... ENSU - Tercer trimestre ...') that pdftotext places inside the slice and one 'ESPECIFIQUE' under option 15, which is printed in trim3 too (checked on a 150-dpi render of p.4) but falls outside the slice in the text layer; stripped in all quarters anyway. No wording change: all 26 distinct Spanish strings shipped (3.1 stem, 17 options, 3.2 and 3.2a stems, 4+2 printed options) are found in the trim3 Section III text layer after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation; option 12 printed 'fraudes, etcetera)' with no period, as in 2025 Q1/Q2 (render of p.4). Versus 2025 Q2 the only difference is the absent corruption block (3.3-3.6, CP3); 3.1-3.2a identical. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 40 live item x level counts (queried server-side via GROUP BY item,resp, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q3 CSV after the .do's recodes, 40/40 (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 9630/14012, bp3_1_10 0/1 = 4122/19520, bp3_1_16 0/1 = 23317/325, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 23619/23, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 863/6346/9885/6130, bp3_2a 1/2 = 8066/14966); raw 23642 rows = 23642 live ids, 448170 live rows (= 17 x 23642 + 23224 + 23032), no duplicate id x item, no missing resp -- not truncated (cf. batch_692). Code 9 set missing by the .do: bp3_2 70, bp3_2a 610. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 blank in raw for 348 = 325 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 23 (bp3_1_99), per 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'. Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered 2025 Q3 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, 'etcetera)' in 12. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space; the visible double space in option 06 'limpia y  recoleccion' collapsed. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; the 3.1 skip instruction). Tarjeta C is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure (same as batch_681/690): section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a (stems in item_text); instructions blank -- Section III has no read-aloud introduction in Q3. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo and bp3_2a 1/2 = Si/No are printed and identical in the catalogos; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (40/40 live item x resp cells). Step 3b instrument: live items match this question block exactly (19 = 17 + 1 + 1); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance, Q3 2025') overstates it -- 3.1 is a city-problems checklist and 3.2/3.2a ask only about the (CIUDAD) government; dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q3 wave (file suffix 0925) -- same defect as the siblings. INEGI-side cosmetic label defect, no effect on shipped text: BP3_1_09 label has a double space after the colon. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_690 (2025 Q1; itself reused from batch_681/673) for every field -- the Spanish is identical string for string, so the file is batch_690's with only table, section_id and instrument ('primer' -> 'tercer trimestre') changed (diffed); nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.2a) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
